capabilities: Draw C4 structure, sequence and data-flow diagrams from a threat code block
Generate a STRIDE threat report note with register, controls and risk matrix
Highlight threat model syntax while typing
Open .threat files as threat models of their own
Check models and list errors and warnings with line numbers
extras: Makes no network requests and writes files only when a report is saved or a .threat file is edited. The full model language is documented separately in docs/language.md; diagram colours can be changed with CSS snippet variables.
problem: A note can describe a system's parts, trust zones and threats, but Obsidian gives no way to draw them as C4 or data-flow diagrams or to turn them into a threat report.

relations.evidence: so Obsidian's Bases or Dataview can list all your threat models and what state they are in
so Obsidian's Bases or Dataview can list all your threat models and what state they are in

summary: Plugin that turns threat-model code blocks in notes into C4 structure, sequence and data-flow diagrams and a STRIDE threat report.
